## Motivation

SpecForge ([sgl-project/SpecForge#1031](https://github.com/sgl-project/SpecForge/pull/1031)) trains DFlash-family drafts (DFlash, DFlash2, DSpark) whose FFN is a mixture of experts. The export stacks the experts as `experts.gate_up_proj` [E, 2I, H] / `experts.down_proj` [E, H, I] and may ship a trained router bias (`gate.expert_bias`, DeepSeek-style: it shifts which experts are picked, never their weights).

SGLang's draft classes only build the dense `DFlashMLP`, and `DFlashDraftModel.load_weights` ignores unknown tensors, so such an export starts a server whose draft FFNs are uninitialized. This PR makes the DFlash family's FFN config-driven: a draft config with routed experts, in the HF conventions the Qwen, DeepSeek and Mixtral families share, is served by the existing classes (`DFlashDraftModel`, `DFlash2DraftModel`, `Qwen3DSparkModel`, ...) with no new architecture names and no dependency on a SpecForge model family.

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/models/dflash.py`:

- `parse_dflash_moe_spec(config)`: the MoE FFN the config describes, or `None` for a dense draft. Fields: `num_experts` / `n_routed_experts` / `num_local_experts`, `num_experts_per_tok`, `moe_intermediate_size` (falls back to `intermediate_size`), `hidden_act` (silu), `scoring_func` (softmax or sigmoid), `norm_topk_prob`, `n_group` / `topk_group` / `topk_method` (group-limited top-k), `routed_scaling_factor`, and `shared_expert_intermediate_size` (Qwen's sigmoid-gated shared expert) or `n_shared_experts` (DeepSeek's summed ones).
- `DFlashMoE`: `ReplicatedLinear` router, SGLang's `TopK` for that routing, `get_moe_impl_class(quant_config)` (`FusedMoE`) for the experts, `Qwen2MoeMLP` as the shared expert, one TP all-reduce over the routed and shared partial sums. The router bias is decided by the checkpoint alone: `gate.expert_bias` or `gate.e_score_correction_bias` loads into an fp32 buffer and re-creates the `TopK` with it as `correction_bias`; with plain softmax scores the biased top-k runs in torch via `custom_routing_function`, because the fused softmax routers (`moe_fused_gate`) keep softmax routing bias-free. No bias in the checkpoint means SGLang's unbiased top-k.
- `build_dflash_ffn` picks `DFlashMoE` over `DFlashMLP` when the config has routed experts; `DFlashDecoderLayer` builds its FFN through it, so DFlash2's conv wrapping and DSpark inherit it unchanged.
- Loading: `DFlashDraftModel.load_weights` hands `layers.{i}.mlp.*` of MoE layers to the block. Stacked and per-expert expert names go through `FusedMoE.weight_loader` (TP/EP sharding stays its job); `shared_expert.*` and `shared_experts.*` both map to the shared expert. It refuses MoE tensors aimed at a dense layer, a shared expert or gate the config does not describe, shape mismatches, and (`check_loaded`) a partially loaded FFN.
- Guards: `--moe-a2a-backend` other than `none` (the draft runs the standard dispatcher), `flashinfer_trtllm_routed` together with a router bias (in-kernel routing would drop it), non-silu experts.

Tests:

- `test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_moe_ffn.py` (CPU): the spec from Qwen-style and DeepSeek-style fields, the dense/MoE switch, stacked vs per-expert vs `model.`-prefixed loading against `FusedMoE`'s own loader, the DeepSeek names, the DSpark path, every refusal, the biased softmax routing math.
- `test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_moe_ffn_cuda.py` (nightly, 1 GPU): the block against a torch reference: biased and plain softmax top-k, sigmoid top-k with the DeepSeek bias, gated and summed shared experts.

## Accuracy Tests

All on one H200 in the `lmsysorg/sglang:dev` image (main @ c10e0e17) with this commit cherry-picked:

- `test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_moe_ffn.py` (CPU): 8 passed, 17 subtests. `test_dflash_moe_ffn_cuda.py`: 4 passed.
- SpecForge's Qwen3-8B MoE DSpark export (5 layers, 8 experts x 1536, top-1, router bias; [yushengsu/new-repo-qwen3-8b-moe16x768-16A1-dspark](https://huggingface.co/yushengsu/new-repo-qwen3-8b-moe16x768-16A1-dspark), step-4784), every layer through `DFlashMoE` against an fp32 torch reference of the trained MoELayer on 4096 tokens: top-1 agreement 0.998-0.999, mean relative output difference 3.3e-3 to 3.7e-3, cosine >= 0.999; `torch.cuda.graph` capture and replay equal to eager at bs 1 / 8 / 32.
- Served end to end (`--speculative-algorithm DSPARK`, Qwen3-8B target, bf16, flashinfer, greedy, 16 gsm8k-style prompts x 256 tokens): the draft verify CUDA graph captured for bs 1..48; `spec_accept_length` 6.75 (gamma 16) and 5.22 (gamma 8) at concurrency 1, 6.5-6.8 / 5.1-5.3 at concurrency 8 and 32. The checkpoint is 0.44 epoch into its run; the fully trained dense 5-layer draft of the same shape ([jiapingW/Qwen3-8b-dspark-SpecForge](https://huggingface.co/jiapingW/Qwen3-8b-dspark-SpecForge)) gives 9.73 / 6.65 on the same prompts and server, so the gap is training maturity, not serving.
- SpecForge's own harness (`specforge benchmark --dataset gsm8k --num-prompts 100 --concurrency 1`, thinking off, max 2048 tokens), same server settings, Qwen3-8B target on one H200. The MoE drafts come from the longer run [yushengsu/qwen3-8b-moe16x768-16A1-dspark](https://huggingface.co/yushengsu/qwen3-8b-moe16x768-16A1-dspark) (exports normalized for SpecForge's interim serving package: `architectures=["Qwen3MoeDSparkModel"]`, `gate.selection_bias`; both load through the aliases in this PR), the dense draft is [jiapingW/Qwen3-8b-dspark-SpecForge](https://huggingface.co/jiapingW/Qwen3-8b-dspark-SpecForge) step 39000 (published 9.72 at D16/V16):

  | draft | gamma 16: accept / tok/s | gamma 8: accept / tok/s |
  |---|---|---|
  | dense 12288, step 39000 | 10.05 / 1106 | 7.04 / 868 |
  | MoE 8x1536 top-1, step 38000 | 9.65 / 1058 | 6.90 / 859 |
  | MoE 8x1536 top-1, step 43000 | 9.69 / 1050 | 6.93 / 861 |
  | MoE 8x1536 top-1, step 56000 | – | 6.96 / 862 |

  The other datasets of the harness at gamma 8, concurrency 1 (accept length / tok/s; dense vs MoE step 56000, the best of the run's checkpoints 43000-57000 by the five-dataset mean; all of them lie within 0.3% of it):

  | dataset (prompts) | dense | MoE | accept delta |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | gsm8k (100) | 7.04 / 863 | 6.96 / 862 | -1.1% |
  | math500 (100) | 6.85 / 858 | 6.83 / 864 | -0.4% |
  | humaneval (164) | 6.00 / 773 | 5.96 / 776 | -0.6% |
  | mbpp (200) | 5.76 / 716 | 5.67 / 717 | -1.5% |
  | mt-bench (80) | 4.33 / 475 | 4.39 / 488 | +1.2% |
  | five-dataset mean | 6.00 / 737 | 5.96 / 741 | -0.6% |

- The biased softmax routing was also checked against SpecForge's `TopKRouter` on random inputs: identical picks and weights.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Dense drafts build the same modules as before. MoE drafts run `FusedMoE` (the Triton runner under `--moe-runner-backend auto` for bf16; no tuned config exists yet for `E=8,N=1536` on H200, the log says so).

Width-8 concurrency sweep on one H200 (Qwen3-8B target, `--speculative-dspark-block-size 8`, `--max-running-requests 256`, graphs captured up to bs 256, 4x concurrency requests of 256 tokens each), time per verify step from each request's `e2e_latency / spec_verify_ct`:

| concurrency | 1 | 8 | 32 | 64 | 128 | 256 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| dense 12288 draft (step 39000), ms/step | 8.2 | 11.0 | 18.1 | 27.5 | 45.3 | 81.6 |
| MoE 8x1536 top-1 draft (step 43000), ms/step | 8.1 | 11.2 | 18.0 | 26.8 | 43.9 | 78.9 |
| dense, total tok/s | 693 | 3564 | 8389 | 11607 | 14349 | 16207 |
| MoE, total tok/s | 694 | 3472 | 8418 | 11669 | 14834 | 16730 |

At matched acceptance length (6.54 vs 6.60 on this prompt set) the MoE draft's step time and total throughput match the dense draft's at every concurrency (within 3%); the FFN is a small part of a step dominated by the target's verify, so the MoE FFN costs nothing extra in this path.

## Temporary files, to be removed before merge

- `scripts/tune_dflash_moe_draft.py` (commit e4e448a): a wrapper that feeds SGLang's own fused-MoE tuner (`benchmark/kernels/fused_moe_triton/tuning_fused_moe_triton.py`) the draft's expert shape (through `parse_dflash_moe_spec`, as the server reads it) and the token counts a DSpark server runs the draft FFN with (block size x concurrent requests), then drops the result where the runtime loader looks. SGLang already ships the tuner, so this file only makes the numbers reproducible; drop it before merge.
- `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/moe_runner/triton_utils/configs/triton_3_8_0/E=8,N=1536,device_name=NVIDIA_H200.json` (commit 2ff71c1): the config that script produced for the 8 x 1536 top-1 draft on H200 (token counts 8..2048, Triton 3.8.0). With it the server logs `Using MoE kernel config from ...` instead of the default-config warning, and the draft segment of a DSpark step measured with `SGLANG_DSPARK_DEBUG_DUMP` goes from 1.78 / 2.31 / 2.67 / 5.45 ms to 1.72 / 2.08 / 2.50 / 5.16 ms at concurrency 1 / 8 / 32 / 128 (dense draft: 1.85 / 2.07 / 2.53 / 6.35 ms). Kernel configs are contributed in their own PRs, so drop this file before merge as well, or move it there.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+            f"moe_intermediate_size, got {top_k} and {intermediate_size}."

+            f"DFLASH MoE draft num_experts_per_tok={top_k} exceeds "
+            f"num_experts={num_experts}."

+    if scoring_func not in ("softmax", "sigmoid"):

+            f"scoring_func={scoring_func!r}."

+<!-- Companion of scripts/tune_dflash_moe_draft.py and the DFlash/DSpark MoE draft support in this PR (sgl-project/sglang#47181). The benchmark scripts referenced below live in yushengsu-thu/SpecForge#10, serving-bench/qwen3-8b-dspark-moe/. -->
+
+# Evaluating a SpecForge MoE DSpark draft end to end: serving, kernel tuning, results
+
+This guide takes any MoE DSpark draft trained with SpecForge (for example the Qwen3-8B 2 x 12288 top-1 draft, or the 8 x 1536 one)
+from an HF export to the agreed result tables and chart. It uses two pull requests:
+
+| PR | what it provides |
+|---|---|
+| [sgl-project/sglang#47181](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47181) (`yushengsu-thu:dflash-moe-ffn`) | the serving side: SGLang builds the draft's MoE FFN from the HF config fields (`DFlashMoE` in `python/sglang/srt/models/dflash.py`, the `Qwen3MoeDSparkModel` alias in `dspark.py`), runs it through SGLang's `FusedMoE` (Triton fused-MoE kernel), and loads a tuned kernel config for the draft's expert shape when one is present. |
+| [yushengsu-thu/SpecForge#10](https://github.com/yushengsu-thu/SpecForge/pull/10) (`dspark-moe-serving-bench`, directory `serving-bench/qwen3-8b-dspark-moe/`) | the benchmark side: checkpoint selection by accept length (`ckpt-sweep/`), the per-task and mixed-workload throughput protocol (`mixed-and-tasks/`), **kernel tuning** (`tune/`), the **report generator** (`make_report.py`), and the results of the 8 x 1536 and 2 x 12288 drafts (`RESULTS.md`, `RESULTS-2x12288.md`). |
+
+The pipeline is: build SGLang with #47181 -> point the server at your draft -> tune the fused-MoE kernel config for the draft's expert
+shape -> run the throughput protocol (dense baseline once, MoE with the tuned config) -> `make_report.py`.
+
+Hardware assumed below: a box with 8 x H200, nothing else running on the GPUs you use (every script checks that its GPU has no compute
+process and under 1 GB in use before starting a server, and refuses otherwise). Times are for H200 / Triton 3.8.0.
+
+## 1. Set up the two PRs
+
+### 1a. SGLang with #47181 (serving)
+
+Either check out the PR branch:
+
+```bash
+git clone -b dflash-moe-ffn https://github.com/yushengsu-thu/sglang.git sglang
+cd sglang && python -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate
+pip install torch==2.14.1            # the Rust TreeCore extension needs torch at build time
+pip install -e "python[all]" --no-build-isolation
+```
+
+or apply the PR to SGLang main `c10e0e17` with the patch shipped in SpecForge#10 (`serving-bench/qwen3-8b-dspark-moe/pr47181-sglang-c10e0e17.patch`,
+`git am -3`). The build used for all numbers here is main `c10e0e17` + #47181, torch 2.14.1+cu130, flashinfer 0.7.2, triton 3.8.0.
+Check: `python -c "from sglang.srt.models.dflash import DFlashMoE; print('ok')"`.
+
+### 1b. SpecForge#10 (benchmark client and scripts)
+
+```bash
+git clone -b dspark-moe-serving-bench https://github.com/yushengsu-thu/SpecForge.git SpecForge-serve
+pip install --no-deps -e SpecForge-serve          # the `specforge benchmark` client; --no-deps keeps the serving venv's torch/transformers
+pip install click datasets tqdm pydantic pyyaml psutil requests safetensors huggingface-hub accelerate   # whatever of these is missing
+export HF_HOME=/scratch/hf_home                   # writable cache: the client downloads gsm8k / math500 / humaneval / mbpp / mt-bench on first use
+```
+
+The scripts live in `SpecForge-serve/serving-bench/qwen3-8b-dspark-moe/`. They were written for a fixed box layout; copy them to a work dir
+(`BENCH_DIR`, default `/scratch/ckpt-sweep/bench`) and set the few paths they take from the environment:
+
+```bash
+B=/scratch/ckpt-sweep/bench; mkdir -p $B/logs
+cp SpecForge-serve/serving-bench/qwen3-8b-dspark-moe/mixed-and-tasks/* SpecForge-serve/serving-bench/qwen3-8b-dspark-moe/tune/* $B/
+ln -s /path/to/sglang/venv $B/venv                 # task_sweep*.sh / mixed_sweep.sh activate $B/venv for the server
+# client: CLIENT_PY (a python that can import specforge) and SPECFORGE_SRC (the SpecForge-serve checkout) are read by the sweep scripts
+```
+
+Target model: a local directory of `Qwen/Qwen3-8B` (`TARGET`, default `/scratch/moe2ep/models/Qwen3-8B`). Dense reference draft:
+`jiapingW/Qwen3-8b-dspark-SpecForge` (its root files; default `/scratch/moe8b16/eval/models/jw-dense`).
+
+## 2. Load your MoE draft
+
+Use the HF export of the checkpoint (SpecForge's per-step `step-N/` / `epoch-k/` folders are already in this layout: `config.json` +
+`model.safetensors` (+ tokenizer files)). The server needs these `config.json` fields:
+
+| field | value |
+|---|---|
+| `architectures` | `["Qwen3MoeDSparkModel"]` (SpecForge exports may say `Qwen3DSparkModel`; change it) |
+| `num_experts`, `num_experts_per_tok`, `moe_intermediate_size`, `norm_topk_prob` | the draft's MoE shape (e.g. 2 / 1 / 12288 / false) |
+| `dflash_config.moe_router_selection_bias` (older exports) or the newer expert-bias naming | router bias on/off; both tensor names (`gate.selection_bias`, `gate.expert_bias`) are accepted |
+| `hidden_size`, `num_hidden_layers`, attention fields, `dflash_config.target_layer_ids`, `markov_*` | as exported |
+
+Start a server and check the log:
+
+```bash
+python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path $TARGET --tp-size 1 --dtype bfloat16 --attention-backend flashinfer \
+  --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --trust-remote-code --host 127.0.0.1 --port 31600 --max-running-requests 256 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 256 \
+  --context-length 16384 --disable-radix-cache --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-draft-model-path /path/to/draft \
+  --speculative-dspark-block-size 7
+```
+
+The log must contain `DFLASH MoE FFN: <E> routed experts, width <N>, routing softmax top-1, expert_bias=True, shared=none, runner=triton` and
+`Initialized DSpark draft runner ... gamma=7, verify_num_draft_tokens=8`. Before a tuned config exists it also says
+`Using default MoE kernel config. Performance might be sub-optimal!` — that is what step 3 fixes.
+
+`--speculative-dspark-block-size 7` is the V8 setting (7 drafted tokens, verify width 8) used for every number in this repository; block size 15
+is V16. If you need to choose among several checkpoints first, `ckpt-sweep/` runs the accept-length eval over a list of exports
+(`sweep_all.sh`, `summarize_sweep.py`) — rank by pooled request-macro accept length.
+
+## 3. Tune the fused-MoE kernel config for the draft (`tune/`, see `tune/README.md`)
+
+Why: SGLang picks Triton tile parameters for the MoE GEMMs from a per-shape JSON; without one it uses a heuristic that, for a draft batch of 7
+tokens, lands on the large-batch config. For the 2 x 12288 draft that alone cost 9-12% of e2e throughput; the tuned, TMA-aware configs
+brought the MoE draft to within 1-5% of the dense draft (accept length is unaffected: the config only changes tiling).
+
+1. Write a stand-in config for the tuner (it reads the MoE shape through the `Qwen3MoeForCausalLM` path), e.g. `shape-cfg/config.json`:
+   ```json
+   {"architectures": ["Qwen3MoeForCausalLM"], "model_type": "qwen3_moe", "hidden_size": 4096, "intermediate_size": 12288,
+    "moe_intermediate_size": 12288, "num_experts": 2, "num_experts_per_tok": 1, "norm_topk_prob": false, "num_hidden_layers": 5,
+    "num_attention_heads": 32, "num_key_value_heads": 8, "head_dim": 128, "vocab_size": 151936, "dtype": "bfloat16"}
+   ```
+   Change `num_experts`, `moe_intermediate_size`, `num_experts_per_tok`, `num_hidden_layers` to your draft's values.
+2. Choose the token-count buckets: the kernel sees M = (draft tokens per request) x (requests in the batch) = 7 x c at block size 7.
+   Default buckets `7 56 112 224 448 896 1792 3584` cover c = 1, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256 and prefill batches; the loader picks the nearest bucket.
+3. Run (one bucket per GPU; ~15 min per bucket with the pruned 648-config search, ~1 h with `FULL_SPACE=1`):
+   ```bash
+   SHAPE_CFG=/path/shape-cfg DRAFT=/path/to/draft TARGET=$TARGET OUT=/scratch/moe-config-mydraft \
+     bash $B/tune_moe_draft_e2e.sh
+   ```
+   It writes balanced top-1 routing dumps, runs `tune_tma_one.py` per bucket (down GEMM with/without TMA, then up GEMM with/without TMA, best
+   joint BLOCK_M), assembles `$OUT/configs/triton_<ver>/E=<E>,N=<N>,device_name=<GPU>.json` (+ `_down.json`), then starts one server with
+   `SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR=$OUT` and checks the log says `Using MoE kernel config from ...`, `Up MoE TMA is enabled`, `Down MoE TMA is enabled`,
+   measures accept length (must equal the untuned value) and draft / verify / step time at c = 1, 8, 32, 128.
+4. Serve with the config: `SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR=$OUT python -m sglang.launch_server ...` (or copy the two JSON files into sglang's
+   `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/moe_runner/triton_utils/configs/triton_<ver>/`). The config is specific to the expert shape, GPU model and
+   Triton version; another checkpoint of the same architecture reuses it, a different shape or GPU needs a new tune.
+
+`--moe-runner-backend` / `--speculative-moe-runner-backend` do not reach a DSpark draft in `c10e0e17` + #47181 (the draft is built before the
+MoE flags are initialized), so the Triton kernel above is what runs; `tune/sglang-dflash-init-moe-config.patch` fixes that if you want to try
+`flashinfer_cutlass` or `triton_kernel` (both measured slower or equal for the 2 x 12288 shape).
+
+## 4. Run the throughput protocol
+
+Rules: one server + one client per empty GPU, TP=1, block size 7, 5 repeat groups per draft, accept length measured once at c=1, per task
+`specforge benchmark` with the full prompt sets (gsm8k 1319, math500 500, humaneval 164, mbpp 257, mt-bench 160; temperature 0,
+max_new_tokens 2048) at c = 1/8/16/32/64 (+128/256 for gsm8k and math500), and the mixed stream (`mixed_bench.py`: the five sets shuffled
+into one 2,400-request stream, seed 42) at c = 1 ... 256.
+
+- Dense baseline (once per box; reuse afterwards): `mixed-and-tasks/task_sweep.sh` and `mixed_sweep.sh` per group, e.g. groups
+  `dense-g1 ... dense-g5` (`GPUS=<gpu> PORT=<port> BENCH_DIR=$B bash task_sweep.sh dense-g1 $DENSE_DRAFT`, then `mixed_sweep.sh`).
+- MoE with the tuned config: `SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR=$OUT PREFIX=moe-mydraft bash $B/run_e2e_tma2.sh` runs the 5 groups split into units
+  (big tasks / small tasks / mixed c=1 / mixed c>=8) over 8 GPUs in about 70 min, or `E2E=1` on the tune script above does it right after
+  tuning. Units of one group are named `<prefix>-gX-{big,small,m1,mrest}`.
+- Results land in `$B/logs/tasks/<name>/<task>_c<c>.json` and `$B/logs/mixed/<name>/mixed_c<c>.json`; every server start logs its GPU check,
+  and the MoE server logs must show the tuned config lines from step 3.
+
+## 5. Generate the results and the chart (`make_report.py`)
+
+```bash
+python $B/make_report.py \
+  --dense $B/logs:dense-g1,dense-g2,dense-g3,dense-g4,dense-g5 \
+  --moe   $B/logs:moe-mydraft-g1-big+moe-mydraft-g1-small,moe-mydraft-g2-big+moe-mydraft-g2-small,moe-mydraft-g3-big+moe-mydraft-g3-small,moe-mydraft-g4-big+moe-mydraft-g4-small,moe-mydraft-g5-big+moe-mydraft-g5-small \
+  --out report/
+```
+
+(`dirA+dirB` joins the unit dirs of one group; mixed units are found automatically from the matching `-m1` / `-mrest` names.) `report/report.md`
+contains, in this order and format:
+
+1. Accept length: `| | Avg (all requests) | Avg (per task) | gsm8k | math500 | humaneval | mbpp | mt-bench |`, rows dense / MoE / diff / diff %
+   (Avg (all requests) = pooled request-macro over the 2,400 requests, Avg (per task) = mean of the five task values).
+2. One table per task: `| c | dense tok/s | MoE tok/s | diff % | dense step ms | MoE step ms |`, cells mean ± sample std over the groups,
+   diff = difference of the means; step ms = latency x min(c, requests) / verify steps.
+3. The mixed stream in the same format (step ms = mean per-request e2e latency / verify steps).
+4. `report/mixed_throughput.png`: x = 1, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256 equally spaced, y = tok/s from 0, dense blue circles, MoE orange squares,
+   title "Qwen3-8B DSpark, block size 7: e2e throughput, dense vs MoE draft (mixed workload, 5 datasets)".
+
+A repeat more than 25% off its cell median is dropped and listed at the end (a one-off stall in a 6-second measurement, not a kernel effect).
+`RESULTS-2x12288.md` is this output for the 2 x 12288 draft.
+
+## Timings and pitfalls
+
+- Tune 15 min (pruned) to 1 h (full) per bucket per GPU; MoE 5-group protocol ~70 min on 8 GPUs; dense baseline the same, once.
+- The first server start with `flashinfer_cutlass` JIT-compiles its SM90 MoE module (~15 min); Triton configs are compiled at CUDA-graph
+  capture (~1 min).
+- Measure dense and MoE on the same box if you can: two H200 boxes differed by -0.6 ... +1.4% on the dense gsm8k sweep.
+- Keep the accept length identical between untuned and tuned runs: a changed value means the config changed numerics or the weights were
+  loaded in the wrong order (gate/up swap).

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Tune sglang's Triton fused-MoE kernel for the MoE FFN of a DFlash/DSpark draft export.
+
+Temporary helper for sgl-project/sglang#47181, to be removed before merge: sglang already ships the tuner
+(benchmark/kernels/fused_moe_triton/tuning_fused_moe_triton.py). This script only feeds it the draft's expert
+shape, read the way the server reads it (``parse_dflash_moe_spec``), and the token counts a DSpark server runs
+the draft FFN with (block size x concurrent requests), then moves the result where the runtime loader looks.
+
+Example:
+    python scripts/tune_dflash_moe_draft.py --draft /path/to/draft-export --block-size 8
+    # -> python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/moe_runner/triton_utils/configs/triton_<ver>/E=8,N=1536,device_name=NVIDIA_H200.json
+
+With --output-dir DIR the file goes to DIR/configs/triton_<ver>/ and the server needs SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR=DIR.
+Needs an sglang source checkout (editable install) and ray; uses every visible GPU.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY = [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 192, 256]
+
+
+def tuner_dir(explicit: str | None) -> Path:
+    if explicit:
+        path = Path(explicit).expanduser().resolve()
+        return path if path.is_dir() else path.parent
+    import sglang
+
+    repo = (
+        Path(sglang.__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    )  # <repo>/python/sglang/__init__.py
+    path = repo / "benchmark" / "kernels" / "fused_moe_triton"
+    if not (path / "tuning_fused_moe_triton.py").is_file():
+        sys.exit(
+            f"tuner not found at {path}; pass --tuner (needs an sglang source checkout)"
+        )
+    return path
+
+
+def in_tree_config_root() -> Path:
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner.triton_utils import fused_moe_triton_config
+
+    return Path(fused_moe_triton_config.__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--draft",
+        required=True,
+        help="DFlash/DSpark draft export (config.json + weights)",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--block-size",
+        type=int,
+        default=8,
+        help="the server's --speculative-dspark-block-size: draft tokens per request per step",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--concurrency",
+        type=int,
+        nargs="+",
+        default=DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY,
+        help="concurrent requests to cover; tokens per step = block size x concurrency",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--tp-size", type=int, default=1)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--dtype",
+        default="auto",
+        choices=["auto", "fp8_w8a8", "int8_w8a16", "int8_w8a8", "int4_w4a16"],
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--output-dir",
+        default=None,
+        help="config root; default is sglang's in-tree one (picked up automatically), "
+        "anything else needs SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR=<dir> on the server",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--tuner", default=None, help="tuning_fused_moe_triton.py or its directory"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--dry-run",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="print the plan and the tuner command only",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    import triton
+
+    from sglang.srt.models.dflash import parse_dflash_moe_spec
+    from sglang.srt.utils.hf_transformers_utils import get_config
+
+    config = get_config(args.draft, trust_remote_code=True)
+    spec = parse_dflash_moe_spec(config)
+    if spec is None:
+        sys.exit(
+            f"{args.draft}: the config has no routed experts (dense draft), nothing to tune"
+        )
+    hidden_size = int(config.hidden_size)
+    batch_sizes = sorted({args.block_size * c for c in args.concurrency})
+    version_dir = f"triton_{triton.__version__.replace('.', '_')}"
+    root = (
+        Path(args.output_dir).expanduser().resolve()
+        if args.output_dir
+        else in_tree_config_root()
+    )
+    dest_dir = root / "configs" / version_dir
+    tdir = tuner_dir(args.tuner)
+
+    # The tuner takes the expert shape from an HF config by architecture name, so hand it a stub
+    # of a known MoE architecture that carries the draft's shape.
+    stub = {
+        "architectures": ["Qwen3MoeForCausalLM"],
+        "model_type": "qwen3_moe",
+        "hidden_size": hidden_size,
+        "intermediate_size": hidden_size,
+        "moe_intermediate_size": spec.intermediate_size,
+        "num_experts": spec.num_experts,
+        "num_experts_per_tok": spec.top_k,
+        "num_hidden_layers": 1,
+        "num_attention_heads": 1,
+        "num_key_value_heads": 1,
+        "vocab_size": 32,
+        "torch_dtype": "bfloat16",
+    }
+    cmd = [
+        sys.executable,
+        "tuning_fused_moe_triton.py",
+        "--model",
+        "<stub>",
+        "--tp-size",
+        str(args.tp_size),
+        "--dtype",
+        args.dtype,
+        "--tune",
+        "--batch-sizes",
+        *map(str, batch_sizes),
+    ]
+    print(
+        f"draft {args.draft}: E={spec.num_experts} top-k={spec.top_k} N={spec.intermediate_size} "
+        f"hidden={hidden_size} shared-expert={spec.shared_intermediate_size or 'none'}"
+    )
+    print(f"tokens per step to tune: {batch_sizes}")
+    print(f"tuner: {tdir}")
+    print(
+        f"destination: {dest_dir}/E={spec.num_experts},N={spec.intermediate_size},device_name=<gpu>.json"
+    )
+    print("command (cwd = tuner dir):", " ".join(cmd))
+    if args.dry_run:
+        return 0
+
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dflash-moe-stub-") as stub_dir:
+        (Path(stub_dir) / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(stub, indent=2) + "\n")
+        cmd[cmd.index("<stub>")] = stub_dir
+        before = {p: p.stat().st_mtime for p in tdir.glob("E=*.json")}
+        subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=tdir, check=True)
+        produced = [
+            p
+            for p in tdir.glob(
+                f"E={spec.num_experts},N={spec.intermediate_size},*.json"
+            )
+            if p not in before or p.stat().st_mtime > before[p]
+        ]
+        if not produced:
+            sys.exit("the tuner finished but wrote no E=*,N=*.json next to itself")
+        src = max(produced, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
+        dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        dest = dest_dir / src.name

+                "shared_experts.gate_proj.weight": rand(I, H),
+                "shared_experts.up_proj.weight": rand(I, H),
+                "shared_experts.down_proj.weight": rand(H, I),
+            }
+        )
+    return weights
+
+
+def _reference(x, w, *, scoring_func, renormalize):
+    """The routing in fp32: scores (softmax or sigmoid), picks shifted by the
+    router bias when the checkpoint has one, unbiased weights, optional
+    renormalization; SwiGLU experts; a gated or summed shared expert."""
+    x = x.float()
+    logits = x @ w["gate.weight"].float().T
+    scores = (
+        torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
+        if scoring_func == "softmax"
+        else torch.sigmoid(logits)
+    )
+    bias = w.get("gate.expert_bias", w.get("gate.e_score_correction_bias"))
+    choice = scores if bias is None else scores + bias
+    ids = torch.topk(choice, k=K, dim=-1).indices
+    weights = scores.gather(-1, ids)
+    if renormalize:
+        weights = weights / weights.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+    gate_up, down = w["experts.gate_up_proj"].float(), w["experts.down_proj"].float()
+    out = torch.zeros_like(x)
+    for slot in range(K):
+        for expert in range(E):
+            rows = ids[:, slot] == expert
+            if not rows.any():
+                continue
+            gate, up = (x[rows] @ gate_up[expert].T).chunk(2, dim=-1)
+            hidden = torch.nn.functional.silu(gate) * up
+            out[rows] += weights[rows, slot, None] * (hidden @ down[expert].T)
+    for prefix in ("shared_expert.", "shared_experts."):
+        if prefix + "gate_proj.weight" not in w:
+            continue
+        gate = x @ w[prefix + "gate_proj.weight"].float().T
+        up = x @ w[prefix + "up_proj.weight"].float().T
+        shared = (torch.nn.functional.silu(gate) * up) @ w[
+            prefix + "down_proj.weight"
+        ].float().T
+        if "shared_expert_gate.weight" in w:
+            shared = (
+                torch.sigmoid(x @ w["shared_expert_gate.weight"].float().T) * shared
+            )
+        out += shared
+    return out, ids
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "needs a GPU")
+class TestDFlashMoEForward(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        init_single_process_dist(master_port=29635)
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        config = get_context().override_server_args(model_path="dummy")
+        config.install()
+        self.addCleanup(config.restore)
+        initialize_moe_config()
+        parallel = get_parallel().override(
+            moe_ep_size=1,
+            moe_ep_rank=0,
+            moe_tp_size=1,
+            moe_tp_rank=0,
+            tp_size=1,
+            tp_rank=0,
+        )
+        parallel.__enter__()
+        self.addCleanup(parallel.__exit__, None, None, None)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _block(style, **overrides):
+        previous = torch.get_default_dtype()
+        torch.set_default_dtype(torch.bfloat16)
+        try:
+            with torch.device("cuda"):
+                return DFlashMoE(_config(style, **overrides), layer_id=0)
+        finally:
+            torch.set_default_dtype(previous)
+
+    def _check(self, style, *, expert_bias, shared, renormalize):
+        overrides = dict(norm_topk_prob=renormalize)
+        if not shared:
+            overrides.update(shared_expert_intermediate_size=0, n_shared_experts=0)
+        block = self._block(style, **overrides)
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1)
+        weights = _weights(generator, style, shared=shared, expert_bias=expert_bias)
+        for key, tensor in weights.items():
+            block.load_weight(key, tensor)
+        block.check_loaded("test")
+        block.experts.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(block.experts)
+        self.assertEqual(block.has_expert_bias, expert_bias)
+        self.assertIn(f"expert_bias={expert_bias}", block.describe())
+
+        x = (torch.randn(T, H, generator=generator, device="cuda") * 0.5).to(
+            torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            picks = block.topk(x, block.gate(x)[0]).topk_ids
+            out = block(x.clone())  # the runner may overwrite its input
+        ref, ids = _reference(
+            x, weights, scoring_func=block.spec.scoring_func, renormalize=renormalize
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.equal(picks.long().sort(dim=-1).values, ids.sort(dim=-1).values),
+            "the served router picks other experts than the reference",
+        )
+        assert_output_close(self, out, ref, cos_threshold=0.995, rtol=2e-2, atol=1e-2)
+
+    def test_specforge_biased_softmax_with_a_gated_shared_expert(self):
+        self._check("qwen", expert_bias=True, shared=True, renormalize=False)
+
+    def test_plain_softmax_renormalized(self):
+        self._check("qwen", expert_bias=False, shared=False, renormalize=True)
+
+    def test_biased_softmax_renormalized(self):
+        self._check("qwen", expert_bias=True, shared=True, renormalize=True)
+
+    def test_deepseek_biased_sigmoid_with_summed_shared_experts(self):
+        self._check("deepseek", expert_bias=True, shared=True, renormalize=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
